seo.title: Valencia Dentistry | Holistic Dentist in Santa Clarita
seo.description: Holistic, one-on-one dentistry in Valencia, Santa Clarita. Dr. Neda Moezzi offers implants, veneers, Invisalign and same-day crowns. $59 new patient exam.

sections.heading: Dentistry that feels calm, personal and thorough.
sections.lead: Dr. Neda Moezzi sees every patient herself, at every visit. Holistic, integrative care with modern technology, in a quiet office on Tourney Road.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS, smiling with her arms crossed

sections.heading: Everything your smile needs, under one roof and one pair of hands.
body: From holistic preventive care and long-term treatment planning to cosmetic and surgical dentistry, you will find it all in our Santa Clarita office. No referrals across town, no starting over with a stranger.
Every consultation is one-on-one with Dr. Moezzi. She takes the time to listen, explain your options plainly and build a plan that fits your health, your goals and your budget.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi and her team in front of the Neda Moezzi DDS sign

sections.heading: Care you can feel the difference in
sections.lead: It is not only the breadth of treatment that keeps patients coming back. It is the relationship Dr. Moezzi builds with each one, and the standard she holds at every appointment.

sections.heading: Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS
sections.quote: To me, dentistry is about more than treating teeth. It is about trust, and real connection.
body: Dr. Moezzi graduated from the University of Detroit Mercy Dental School in 2010 and has been expanding her skills in general, cosmetic and surgical dentistry ever since. She gives every patient her full attention at every appointment: listening first, understanding your goals, then building a plan that supports your long-term health.
Her goal is simple. You should leave every visit feeling comfortable, informed and genuinely cared for.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS, in her office

sections.heading: Trusted by Santa Clarita families
sections.lead: Unedited words from patients who found their dental home here.

items.a: You see Dr. Moezzi herself at every visit. Care is holistic and personal, considering your overall health rather than only your teeth, in a calm, unhurried environment.
Yes. We accept most major PPO plans and can verify your benefits before treatment so there are no surprises.
Yes. We use biocompatible materials and focus on prevention and whole-body wellness, alongside proven clinical techniques and modern imaging.

items.q: Do you offer cosmetic services like veneers or Invisalign?
items.a: Absolutely. Veneers, teeth whitening and Invisalign are all planned and delivered here, customized to your smile.

items.q: What happens during my first visit?
items.a: We review your health history, complete a thorough exam with digital X-rays and take time to understand your goals before discussing any treatment.

items.q: Can I get a crown in one visit?
items.a: Often, yes. Crowns are designed and made in house, so many patients receive their permanent crown the same day.

items.q: Where are you located, and is there parking?
items.a: We are at 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240 in Valencia, Santa Clarita, with free parking on site and an elevator to the second floor.

sections.heading: In the heart of Valencia
sections.lead: Just off the I-5 on Tourney Road, minutes from Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country.

sections.heading: Ready for a dentist who actually listens?
sections.text: Book online in under a minute, or call and talk to a person. New patients receive a comprehensive exam and X-rays for $59.
